test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 20 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six numbers, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25 and 26 are written on different faces of a dice. Three positions of this dice are shown here. Find the number on the face opposite 26.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f98dc76ed0a29766c4b8d166e2295b479754a8f5b0c66a0986fdd67e71d4292.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of '26', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 3,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c75b6aef9a7644f4c99d9daf4749517d98f8f6c53a943529b14e11f89cca3e4.png] 

From both dices, 5 is common. So, we can rotate in clockwise direction start from 26.

24 → 21

23 → 25

26 → 22

So, 22 will be opposite to 26.

Hence, the correct answer is "22".
